hero.title: Simplify your tax procedures
hero.subtitle: Access all Guinean tax services in one place. Calculate your taxes, consult procedures and download your documents.
hero.searchPlaceholder: Search for a tax service, a ministry, a category...

stats.title: A complete platform
stats.description: Access all tax services of Equatorial Guinea, organized clearly and accessibly

features.title: Main features
features.description: Powerful tools to simplify all your administrative and tax procedures
features.intelligentSearchDesc: Quickly find the tax service you need thanks to our advanced search engine with filters by ministry, sector and category.
features.taxCalculatorDesc: Automatically calculate the amount of your taxes and administrative fees for each service. Support for complex expedition and renewal formulas.
features.documentsDesc: View the complete list of required documents and download the necessary forms. Follow the procedures step by step.
features.upToDateDesc: Database regularly updated with the latest rates and procedures. More than 19,000 validated and verified records.
